Never raced and not sure where to start? Start here. One group session a week in Stockport — start whenever, your own pace, nobody judging. Then once a month there's a meetup: class first, then coffee, food and gossip — and honestly, that's the important part. Sit with crew who've done it and see your next step in the flesh.

Weekly group session · monthly meetup — class first, then coffee and treats (the important part, honestly) · starter programme in the app · crew WhatsApp group. Walkers welcome — the podium's a bonus.

How do floor sessions work?

Floor sessions run at the Performance Centre in Stockport — coached, capped in size, and built around your programme. Can't make one? Swap it for a video form review that week. Your programme, check-ins and reviews carry on in the app and WhatsApp regardless.
Not ready to race? Come watch with the crew — free, still a great day out.
Three things per station that Hannah actually does on race day — including the embarrassing ones. Spot a gap? Ask Hannah — it might make the list.

items.a: Depends how you want to train: 1:1 Personal Training — £180 (per month). Online Coaching — £89 (per month). HYROX Sim Entry — £35 (per event). Small Group Sessions — £60 (per month). Rolling monthly, no lock-in — details on the plans section below.
Yes — the 3-Day Trial gives you the full run of the place: sessions, open gym, the lot. Most people who try a week stay.

items.q: I've never done HYROX — can beginners join?
items.a: That's most of the room, honestly. Every station scales, nobody's watching your numbers, and Hannah will tell you the same: show up twice a week and the rest takes care of itself.

An indoor fitness race: eight 1km runs with a workout station between each — SkiErg, sled push, sled pull, burpee broad jumps, row, farmers carry, lunges, wall balls. Open, Pro, Doubles and Relay divisions, so everyone can race.
We're in Stockport — exact session locations go out in the member group each week, and the site has the details under Events. Parking's never been an issue.
Session times are on the diary page and go out weekly in the group — typically early morning and evening slots so it fits around work. Check the diary or just ask.

items.q: Do you run HYROX sim days?
items.a: Yes — full race simulations with real timing and transitions, the closest thing to race day without the ticket. Members get first shout; dates land on the events page.

Yes — 1:1 coaching is on the plans. Technique work, race prep, or just faster progress than group sessions alone. Message Hannah directly and you'll get a straight answer on whether it's worth it for you.
Rolling monthly — cancel whenever, no exit forms, no guilt-trip retention script. If you leave, the door stays open.

items.q: I'm looking for a doubles partner
items.a: Post a card on the find-a-partner board — pace band, race target, one line about you. Hannah matches people by hand, because doubles is chemistry, not just split times.
